release.title: Device-Only Source-Linked Action Planning and Separate Correction Provenance
release.artifactSha256Location: External exact-artifact test record delivered with the final ZIP

changes.problem: Device-only review and comparison did not provide a grounded way to carry exact findings into user-controlled questions, missing-information items, next actions, or notes.
changes.implementation: Added a source-linked action-plan workspace that begins only after a local review, requires affirmative source-finding selection, supports user-authored questions, missing-information items, actions, notes, and optional user-chosen target dates, and renders a plain-language plan.
changes.preserved: No source finding is selected automatically; no legal deadline is calculated; no recommendation, filing, professional review, account save, AI call, payment, or routing is created.

changes.problem: Users could identify an extraction or interpretation issue but could not preserve their correction separately from the exact original line.
changes.implementation: Added line-specific correction records that retain the original source line and user correction or note as separate fields in the interface and structured export.
changes.preserved: The original source text is never overwritten, corrected silently, or represented as changed. User notes remain explicitly user supplied.

changes.problem: A practical next-step organizer needed export and clearing controls without creating persistent sensitive storage.
changes.implementation: Added local text and JSON plan downloads plus clear controls. All plan state remains in page memory and disappears on refresh or tab close unless the user downloads it.
changes.preserved: No fetch, XMLHttpRequest, beacon, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, server API, analytics event, account persistence, or professional sharing was added.

changes.problem: Public entry points described only review and comparison after the action-planning capability was added.
changes.implementation: Updated the document workspace, homepage, notice-description page, and How It Works page to describe review, comparison, separate corrections, and user-controlled planning accurately.
changes.preserved: Free starting help, professional separation, customer-language rules, mobile safeguards, and all launch gates remain unchanged.
